Haggai.text: Now therefore this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.
‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says the LORD of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says the LORD of Armies.”
Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,” says the LORD.

Zechariah.text: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is the LORD’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the LORD of Armies.

Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and having salvation; lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
“In that day there will be a fountain opened to David’s house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.

Malachi.text: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house, and test me now in this,” says the LORD of Armies, “if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there will not be enough room for.
But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out and leap like calves of the stall.
“For I, the LORD, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.

Matthew.text: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

Mark.text: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”

Luke.text: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”
For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

John.text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

Acts.text: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”
There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”
Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

Romans.text: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
